description.zh: 包含TLS证书、CA证书的密钥名称。
description.en: The name of the secret that contains the Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate and the certificate authority (CA) certificate.

description.zh:
是否强制使用TLS保护连接，取值：

- `true`：强制使用TLS保护连接。

- `false`：不强制使用TLS保护连接。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enforce TLS encryption for connections. Valid values:

- `true`: Enforces TLS encryption for connections.

- `false`: Does not enforce TLS encryption for connections.

description.zh: 此网关公开的一个或多个主机，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: One or more hosts exposed by the gateway. Separate multiple hosts with commas (,).
The name of the ASM gateway.

description.zh: 查询网关资源数目上限。
description.en: The maximum number of gateway resources to query.
The port number provided by the gateway.
The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh create-istio-gateway-domains --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --istio-gateway-name ingressgateway --hosts example.com,demo.com --number 443 --port-name http-demo --protocol HTTPS --credential bookinfo-secret --force-https true --namespace default --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh CreateIstioGatewayDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Hosts 'example.com,demo.com' --Credential 'bookinfo-secret' --Number 443 --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --ForceHttps true --Limit 10 --Protocol HTTPS --PortName 'http-demo' --Namespace default --IstioGatewayName ingressgateway
